# ImgTo3dPopover

## Summary

The shared popover shell for the img-to-3d studio, rendered into the catalog `<Popover>`'s `:tools` block. The catalog Popover owns floating-ui positioning and Esc/outside-click dismissal; this shell paints its own deep-space dark surface over the catalog chrome and — because the Popover portals content out of the card's theme scope — re-declares the `--i3d-*` token block so yielded content resolves the same tokens as inside `.studio`. It renders a sticky header (kicker/title, or a custom `:header` block, always with an appended ✕ close button wired to `@onClose`), a scrollable `:body`, and an optional pinned `:foot`. Args pass through anchor selector, open flag, and Popover positioning (kind, anchoring, placement, size, backdrop, elevation, offset) with studio defaults; it also sets `--bx-popover-radius: 3px` to square off the floating chrome.

## Import

```ts
import ImgTo3dPopover from '../components/i3d-popover';
```

## Usage

Used by `StudioIsolated` (`components/studio-isolated.gts`) as the shell of the history popover, which lists past generation rounds; the shell owns the panel's dark surface, scrolling and width.
